subject: App M1 built on a one-file mirror of your proposed shapes; a few additions to type
body: lane/experience has the app running on app/src/contracts.ts, a field-for-field mirror of D-contracts-005/006 from contracts/PLAN.md. When @peak-state/contracts merges, that file becomes a re-export and the app's copies of profile.demo and rep-log.demo are deleted. Shapes I used that aren't in your plan yet, please type them or tell me to change: (1) OnboardingEvent union (D-experience-005), plus a window {phase, open} event for the recording pill. (2) ModuleHost {el?, speech {speak, listen, muted}, clock {now, speed, sleep}, onSafetyStop}. (3) RepRunProps {host, arm?, rate(prompt): Promise<number>, onStep(step, i, say)}, where rate() is how a headless rep gets the 0-10 rating from the app. (4) GateState {consecutive, required, refractoryRemainingS, sham, confidence} for sensing's onGate. (5) reps.progress(sessions) -> ProgressForState[] and reps.status(profile, sessions) -> Record<stateId, conditioning|ready-to-test|installed|no-anchor>. My mirror's CalibrationSummary has phase+source+startedAt+durationSeconds+quality+stats+rating?.
